name: a11-frozen-linkage-evidence
notes: A11 (10 item 7): FROZEN_PROCESS is a stopped process with no CPU progress; its signature-linked evidence must not include another process's CPU saturation events. The ban names types present on the timeline, so it cannot pass vacuously.
The other process's saturation episode remains on the timeline with its own recovery edge; the ban constrains FROZEN_PROCESS linked evidence, not other subjects' episodes.
The stopped worker keeps its honest unknown-cause analysis (stop-sender telemetry is not in v1); the stop never resumes, so the graph is unhealthy.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.

missing_evidence_includes: stop-sender telemetry (who sent SIGSTOP/ptrace) is not captured in v1 bundles
